title: Ensure all checks have passed before merging new code
description: A pipeline that runs but cannot block a merge is decoration. Tests, linters, and security scans only reduce risk if a red result stops the merge.
remediation: Repository settings -> Required builds -> Add required build: name the CI plan key and set the ref matcher to the default branch. Alternatively, Repository settings -> Pull requests -> Merge checks -> "Minimum successful builds" set to at least 1. Required builds is the stronger option because it names which build must pass, not merely how many.
fixSummary: Add the CI plan key at Repository settings -> Required builds, matched to the default branch.
